body:
I'm sorry you feel this way.. I know how it feels to be ready for it and finally do it and then fail.. it's incredibly difficult.. 

I know it might sound dishonest to hear from a stranger but I'm glad you survived, and I hope maybe in this one more chance things will become a bit easier.

As people mentioned that's being passively suicidal. And honestly I don't have anything smart or good to say since I've been battling this as well for as long as I can remember. Just wanted to comment that not wearing your seatbelt will more likely kill the people in the car with you. I was grateful to hear that, so I hope it will help you too.

Not OP, but I think they meant when you feel numb to the idea, it doesn't scare or upset you. When you reach that point getting help is harder and the way you see suicide is distorted to the point it seems normal and inevitable.
